messages.subject: Problem for saving of project
parts:
Hi every everyone?
 
I have qestion about Project save.
After I load progect I've alredy made, I performed new task ( ex> Model)  in this project then I  try  to save project as new name .
But I can't save project as new project
 
Pls let me know the reason and how to.
 
Thanks alote

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Problem for saving of project
parts:
Hi Alote,

More detail will help. I repeated this without a problem:

Load audit dataset
Build a Tree model
Save project
Exit Rattle

Start Rattle
Load project
Build a Forest model
Save project

That worked for me.

What version are you using? There were some project related fixes a
few weeks ago, so it may be wise to use the latest version from
Togaware:

install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

Regards,
Graham
